title: Remove inspector and make canvas full-width
description: Remove the visual inspector Card from the workflow tab and make the canvas container take full width. Update grid layouts to single column.
instructions: In the workflow tab (TabsContent value="workflow"), remove the second Card that contains the visual inspector (lines ~1049-1538). The canvas Card should take full width. Change the grid layout from xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.35fr)_minmax(380px,0.65fr)] to just a single full-width container. Keep all canvas functionality (DndContext, svg connections, WorkflowCanvasNode components). Do NOT remove any state or helper functions - only the JSX layout.
verification: Canvas takes full width, no inspector visible, all existing canvas functionality preserved
